description: This source file defines the SegoeWpFontResolver class, implementing IFontResolver for mapping SegoeWP font family requests to specific embedded font resources. It provides font resolution logic for different font styles within the SegoeWP typeface family, used in PDF rendering.

classes.name: SegoeWpFontResolver
classes.description: Implements IFontResolver to resolve SegoeWP fonts into specific font resources for PDF rendering.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Selects an appropriate font face based on family name, bold, and italic parameters.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Retrieves the byte array for a specified font face name.
